messages:
Sofia: Heads up — release cut is blocked, staging integration keeps failing on session_auth_e2e after cache restore errors. Can't promote.
ci-bot: Job failed: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345 — exit 137 on worker, see logs.
Sofia: log snippet:
```
E   RuntimeError: session token mismatch
...Cache restore: object not found: shards/abcd1234
```
Mike: Ugh. Is this the same flaky test we saw last week?
Elaine: I'm seeing cache-ttl spikes and S3 404s around the same time. Runner CPU also hit 95% on the job. Could be eviction + load.
Anton: Quick triage options: 1) manual-promote previous good image 2) rerun the single test on an isolated runner w/ empty cache 3) rollback PR that touched auth deps.
Sofia: deploy-bot says promotion is blocked: "artifact verification failed" :deploy-bot: — promotion won't go until artifact is validated.
deploy-bot: promotion blocked for release/2026.03.21: artifact verification failed for image sha:deadbeef
Mike: I'll try an isolated rerun: `./scripts/ci-run --job session_auth_e2e --runner isolated-small --no-cache` — gives fresh env. Kicking off now.
ci-bot: Rerun started: build 12346 (isolated-small)
Mike: Rerun finished — same failure after ~4m, same token mismatch.
Elaine: If isolated run also fails, likely a test/regression rather than flaky cache. Any recent PRs touching auth seed or token handling?
Sofia: PR #782 changed the auth lib lockfile and bumped a dep. It was small but landed yesterday.
Anton: Reverting PR during change window is risky. Safer short-term: manual promote to last-good image sha:c0ffee00 and pin release, then bisect the PR after canary.
Mike: Manual promote command: `deploy-bot promote --env staging --image c0ffee00 --reason "pin-last-good-due-to-ci-cache-or-auth-regression"`
Sofia: I'm going to run that now and open a rollback ticket in case production shows anything odd.
deploy-bot: Manual promotion triggered by Sofia. Verifying artifact...
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded (manual) — staging now pinned to image sha:c0ffee00 :white_check_mark: 
Sofia: Great. This preserves the release window. I'll create follow-up: bisect auth PR, add a test that reproduces token mismatch, and add a cache-health gate to CI.
Anton: Can we also add a temporary alert for cache-restore 404 rate > 1% during critical releases?
Elaine: Good idea. I'll add a short retention metric and alert.
Mike: I'll take the bisect and run a narrower test matrix. Assign to me: ticket infra-789.
Sofia: Thanks — assign follow-ups: @Mike (bisect & reruns), @Elaine (cache alert), @Sofia (rollback playbook + postmortem).
Mike: Will do. Proceeding with canary now. :thumbsup:
